hero.desc1: We are professionals dedicated to your recovery.
hero.desc2: Mental wellness is our top priority.

about.desc1: Fenote Psychological Services is a premier mental health practice in Addis Ababa dedicated to providing holistic, culturally sensitive psychological services.
about.desc2: We provide individualized, evidence-based counseling tailored to children, adolescents, youth, adults, and vulnerable populations.
about.desc1_detail: Fenote Psychological Services is a premier mental health practice in Addis Ababa dedicated to providing holistic, culturally sensitive psychological services. Our name, meaning "health" in Ge'ez, reflects our deep commitment to whole-person wellness.
about.desc2_detail: We provide individualized, evidence-based counseling tailored to children, adolescents, youth, adults, and vulnerable populations. From individual therapy to corporate wellness programs, we offer comprehensive services designed to meet you where you are.

blog.desc: Articles, stories, and resources to support your mental health journey.

services.desc: From individual therapy to corporate wellness programs, we offer comprehensive services designed to meet you where you are.

individual.title: Individual Counseling
individual.desc: Evidence-based counseling tailored to children, adolescents, youth, adults, and vulnerable populations. One-on-one sessions addressing personal, emotional, behavioral, and psychological challenges.

group.title: Group Counseling
group.desc: Professionally facilitated sessions bringing together individuals facing similar challenges, promoting peer support, shared learning, and social skill development.

family.title: Family Counseling
family.desc: Engaging parents, children, and family members to strengthen communication, collaborative problem-solving, and overall family cohesion.

virtual.title: Virtual Counseling
virtual.desc: Secure virtual counseling through video conferencing, providing the same professional, ethical, and confidential care as in-person sessions.

telephone.title: Telephone Consultation
telephone.desc: Short-term psychological guidance and emotional support for urgent or follow-up needs, ensuring accessibility and timely assistance.

training-pkg.title: Training Packages (Therapy)
training-pkg.desc: Structured training equipping children, youth, and adults with life skills, psychological first aid, positive parenting, and MHPSS.

relationship.title: Relationship Coaching
relationship.desc: Insights and strategies to foster healthy connections, resolve conflicts, and enhance communication skills in personal or professional relationships.

training-ws.title: Training & Workshops
training-ws.desc: Life skills, personal development, psychological first aid, positive parenting, youth development, and organizational training programs.

career.title: Career Counseling & OD
career.desc: Career counseling and organizational development programs that align individual growth with company goals, maximizing efficiency and effectiveness.

team.desc: Our experienced team is committed to improving mental wellbeing.

clients.desc: Trusted companies that rely on our care.

testimonials.desc: Learn how our supporters are helping promote mental well-being and empower individuals.
